units: <cite ref="Shabbat 28b:10">Sabb. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ אינו מועיל</he> the mere creasing (of an old garment with the purpose of making wicks of it) does not affect it as regards the laws of uncleanness. Y. ib. II, 4ᵈ bot. <he>שכן … רוצים בקִיפּוּלָהּ</he> for professional attendants (dressers) like a garment to be creased. Ib. XV, beg. 15ᵃ <he>ק׳ בשנים וכ׳</he> folding a garment (on the Sabbath) by two persons is treated as forbidden work.
